label: Trial sequence
description: Every trial family and its ordered auditory, tactile, wait, and source-selection elements, with method-defining within-trial timing and condition intermixing.

label: Task and response
description: Target/no-target rule, response or explicit passive/no-response mode, device/mapping, and any method-defining response-window anchor or scoring policy. The current design serializer has no first-class response contract.
runtime_or_untyped_inputs: design.protocol.trial_strips[].metadata::<response/capture/window keys> | session_runner response policy; fixed global defaults remain an implementation gap

label: Jitter and ITI policy
description: Explicit none, fixed, discrete, range, or custom timing policy and whether it is a foreperiod, within-sequence gap, post-sound delay, or true intertrial interval. Audio padding is not silently treated as ITI.

label: SOA schedule
description: Ordered audio-tactile onset schedule with a declared reference/sign convention, or distance-at-touch anchors only when trajectory kinematics can derive the SOAs.

label: Tactile target
description: Tactile modality, body site/side, cue waveform/duration, and method-defining intensity/calibration or trigger mechanics needed to synthesize or route an equivalent cue.
runtime_or_untyped_inputs: design.protocol.trial_strips[].metadata::<tactile waveform/calibration/trigger keys> | session_runner tactile synthesis/runtime inputs

label: Baseline/control trials
description: Explicit absence or a trial-generation control family (for example tactile-only, static/far, SOA-matched, endpoint, sound-offset, or custom), with timing anchor and an exact count or reconstructible allocation. EEG/analysis baselines are excluded.
